entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A werewolf and planeswalker who can control her transformations and acts as an ambassador and protector of her kind.

events.summary: As a teenager Arlinn first succumbs to the werewolf within her and for years tries to hide what she is.
events.quote: Arlinn Kord was a teenager when she first succumbed to the primal call of the werewolf inside her.

events.summary: After becoming a planeswalker, Arlinn discovers she can control her transformations.
events.quote: after becoming a Planeswalker she discovered the power to control her transformations.

events.summary: Arlinn becomes an ambassador and protector of werewolves, brokering a tentative peace with humans.
events.quote: Now, she has become an ambassador and protector of her kind
